text.text_excerpt: As of late, i've been this Mexican food zombie, it's all I've been wanting to eat. The Taqueria Guerrero and I have been getting very acquainted these past couple weeks, but always in the search for more, i finally found myself in front of this food truck. Going somewhat off of the recommendation of fellow Yelper, Charles H., i went with a trio of the corn (pastor) tacos, and a chicken quesadilla, totalling a whopping $11. After devouring that entire meal in one sitting, i felt like I should have paid more (well, I did tip), but those prices are ridiculously fair. So I randomly stopped here because of the smells and the line coming from this small, unassuming food truck. Not one to pass up the chance for a good meal, I stopped and got in line myself. Since I had a chance to talk to others in line, I found out that the tacos are what everyone was standing in line for- although their burritos are a close second. I ended up getting their tacos and a sope. Sope was kind of pricey for a hot-pressed sandwich (tasted like a flavorful panini). Overall, not worth $7 for protein, a little cheese and crusty bread. I always see this food truck whenever I'm in the area and was curious of how it compared to the other trucks. I had a longer lunch break today, so this truck was the first thing to pop in my head! It was cloudy and raining a bit, so I was hoping they would be in the same spot I always saw it. Miraculously, it stopped raining when I got there and the food truck was there! I ordered a Lengua Taco and a Lengua Quesadilla. Right when I told the worker what I wanted, she instantly started working on my order. The wait for it wasn't too long at all!
